name: Lavern
description: Multi-agent legal work system in which specialist agents debate, verify each other's output and pause at human approval gates.
whatItDoes: Runs legal tasks such as contract analysis through a team of role-specific agents and shows the process in a dashboard. Lawyers approve or redirect work at defined checkpoints.
howItWorks: A Node.js server coordinates dozens of prompt-defined agents under a debate protocol with verification steps, and a separate dashboard visualises runs. A local mode works without a key; hosted models are enabled by provider keys.

requirements.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
requirements.description: Hosted model access; MISTRAL_API_KEY is also supported
